figure.description: Four graphs labeled A to D, each on a grid with x from -π/2 to π/2 (marks every π/4) and y from -4 to 4. Graph A: one decreasing branch between the dashed asymptotes x = -π/2 and x = π/2, through (-π/4, 1), (0, 0), and (π/4, -1). Graph B: increasing branches separated by dashed asymptotes at x = -π/4 and x = π/4; the middle branch passes (0, 0). Graph C: a gently increasing curve with no asymptotes in view, through (-π/2, -1), (0, 0), and (π/2, 1). Graph D: one increasing branch between the dashed asymptotes x = -π/2 and x = π/2, through (-π/4, -1), (0, 0), and (π/4, 1).

Graph C: a gently increasing curve with no asymptotes in view, through (-π/2, -1), (0, 0), and (π/2, 1).
Graph D: one increasing branch between the dashed asymptotes x = -π/2 and x = π/2, through (-π/4, -1), (0, 0), and (π/4, 1).
